name: Gate-aligned frontage
summary: Turn the entrance and garage frontage parallel to the main gate, tapering the wing toward its southern end while retaining the existing entrance link.
retained: Original house, entrance link and loft connection, side extension envelope, rear living space, pool, cinema, wine bar and site boundary.
main_changes: Gate-parallel entrance door, garage door and front wing facade
Narrower southern end inside the existing wing's east and south extents
Rooms replanned within the taper using full-size fittings
Existing entrance link and original house geometry retained
status: Concept option; model checks are recorded in the accompanying audit reports.
planning: Concept alternative; reduced new-wing area does not establish planning acceptability. Existing survey, neighbour, tree, drainage and basement matters remain.
